newsitem.title: THAILAND: Jobless Thais offered $323 to make new start.
newsitem.headline: Jobless Thais offered $323 to make new start.

text.p: Some 40,000 Thais are expected to lose their jobs because of the economic slump, but the government said on Friday it was willing to lend them $323 each to start their own business.
The Labour & Social Welfare Ministry said by the third quarter of the year about 40,000 people would lose their jobs, despite the fact that there were about 100,000 job vacancies nationwide.
A ministry spokesman said people who would lose their jobs were mainly from the textile industry who did not qualify for the vacancies.
"The ministry will offer a soft loan of about 10,000 baht (about $323) for each worker who lost his job and is willing to try and start up his own business," he said.
